Context: 2. Determination of Relative Seniority

- 2.2. Inadequate Direct Rear.l!.l.irs.If an adequate number of direct recruits is not available in a particular year, the rotation of quotas for determining seniority is limited to the available direct recruits and promotees. The unfilled direct recruitment vacancies are carried forward to the next year and added to the corresponding direct recruitment vacancies.
